content: अप्रतिसंख्य {%a.%} Unobserved, unnoticed; ˚ख्य(ख्या)निरोधः unobserved nullity, annihilation of an object; one of the three topics included by the Buddhas under the category of निरूप, the other two being प्रतिसंख्यानिरोध wilful destruction, as of a jar by a mallet, and आकाश the ethereal element.
